verdicts.quote: Rejecting a batch on any invalid or conflicting row is a product default that gives the admin a clear correction path and avoids partial imports.
Any record with the wrong number of fields, missing/blank email, or invalid value rejects the whole attempt. Report each offending logical record and an actionable reason.

Any identity repeated in the CSV or already reserved by the authoritative create contract rejects the entire batch. Report the affected row numbers and a conflict reason... Report every occurrence of an in-file repeat.

verdicts.where: R-3 State and open prerequisites; R-2 / File profile
verdicts.quote: Imports do not assign elevated roles, set passwords, update or merge existing users... exactly one decoded field, email... extra header columns... reject the file
An admin with current user-create authority in the active user-management scope can open Import users and submit one selected CSV there.
verdicts.missing: Import is gated on admin status plus ordinary create rights; whether a distinct import permission is required beyond single-user create authority is not decided.

verdicts.quote: The first nonempty logical record is the header, with exactly one decoded field, email... missing or different header, extra header columns, or zero data records reject the file with an actionable reason and zero writes.
Accept UTF-8 comma-separated data, with optional leading UTF-8 BOM, LF or CRLF record separators... Separators inside quoted fields remain field content.
Any definite failure leaves the batch with zero user records and zero import-caused creation side effects.
Exceeding either bound rejects the attempt with the applicable limit and zero writes.
verdicts.missing: The actual byte and data-record maxima are left open for the runtime owner.

verdicts.quote: At zero data records the file is rejected even when its byte length is within the limit... One data record is allowed.
A deliberate fresh resubmission after a successful import is evaluated against current identities.

verdicts.quote: Closing the view after submission does not cancel an attempt the authority already accepted... No cross-admin sharing, history screen, background notification or durable storage of the raw upload is in scope.
